consentModal.title: Hello there, it's cookie time!
consentModal.description: We only use cookies this site cannot work without. The one thing we ask about is embedded video, and you can change that choice any time.
consentModal._footer.comment: The format here is different from the usual next-intl format, and this is intentional. Both links and other text in here can be freely edited.

intro.title: Somebody said ... cookies?
intro.description: Our website uses essential cookies to ensure its proper operation and tracking cookies to understand how you interact with it. The latter will be set only after consent.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary cookies Always enabled
necessary.description: These cookies are required for the website to function properly, including remembering your language preference.

externalMedia.title: External video cookies
externalMedia.description: These cookies let us show embedded videos from external services such as YouTube. Without your consent we only show a link to the video.

moreInfo.title: More information
moreInfo.description: For any queries about our cookie policy and your choices, please contact us.
